Google Ads now works without a developer token, and Adwarp can turn an approved post into a thought leader ad.

### Google Ads without a developer token

- Google sunset Google Ads API developer tokens on September 9, 2026. Access levels now belong to the Google Cloud project that owns your OAuth client, and Google ignores the `developer-token` header and says a future API version will reject it.
- Adwarp no longer asks for a token and never sends the header. An existing `developerToken` in `~/.adwarp/google.json` still loads and is ignored.
- A project with only Test access now gets an error that says where to apply for Explorer access.
- The setup docs describe the access levels (Test, Explorer, Basic), and the consent screen guidance follows Google's brand verification guide: Basic access needs the app set to External and In production. Setup: https://adwarp.dev/docs/google-ads-setup

### Thought leader ads

- New MCP tool `create_post_ad` and CLI command `adwarp ad create-post <campaignId> <post>`. It sponsors a post that already exists, such as a member's post the member approved in Campaign Manager, and creates the ad as a draft.
- It takes a `urn:li:ugcPost:` or `urn:li:share:` URN, or a LinkedIn URL or "Embed this post" code that contains one, and refuses `urn:li:activity:` links, which LinkedIn's API can't use.
- `delete_ad` now deletes the post behind an ad only when it's a dark post the same ad account created, so it never deletes a member's post or an organic Page post.

### Other changes

- Contact list uploads keep first name, last name, company, title and country as plain text next to the hashed email, which LinkedIn uses to match more people.
- The paid ads skills moved to https://github.com/adwarp-dev/paid-ads-skills, with a page for each at https://adwarp.dev/docs/skills.
- New docs for Gemini (Antigravity CLI and Gemini CLI), Meta Muse and Grok Bot, and a safety note: every LinkedIn ad set Adwarp creates has Audience Network and Audience Expansion off.
- `docs/tools.json` lists 38 tools: 29 for LinkedIn Ads and 9 for Google Ads.
